schema.title: Response List Reminders V1 Admin Reminders Get

get.description: Provisioning state, provider ids (no secrets, no phone numbers) and recent events.

post.description:
Enqueue the next provisioning step (owner). 409 if a step is already pending or the
state has no next step. A worker with a Bolna port runs it.

Select an existing number of the Bolna account by id (owner). Nothing is purchased;
the number step checks the id against the account's numbers.
verified -> active (owner). Does not enable outbound contact.

failed | manual_review -> the state whose step must run again (owner). An uncertain
agent create stays pending unless confirm_no_stray_agent is true (409 unless the last
error was create_uncertain or lease_lost).

schema.title: Response List Appointments V1 Admin Appointments Get

post.description: Opt the appointment's patient out of confirmations and/or reminders.

Undo an opt-out of exactly (purpose, channel) for the appointment's patient (the
patient-wide one and the one for this appointment). Suppressed contacts stay suppressed.

409 if the clinic already has an active account, unless replace=true: the previous
active account(s) are retired (token forgotten, not revoked at Google) once the new one
is connected.

Receive a Bolna execution status update. The path token is the clinic's webhook
credential; nothing in the body selects the clinic.

BolnaChangeOut.title: BolnaChangeOut
BolnaChangeOut.description:
changed=false: nothing was changed (read back and call again with confirmed=true).
For a reschedule, booking_reference is the new booking's reference.

BolnaContextOut.title: BolnaContextOut
BolnaContextOut.description: Pre-call variables. Clinic configuration only: no patient or booking data.

BolnaOptOut.title: BolnaOptOut
BolnaOptOut.description:
Stop reminders and confirmations of one booking verified on this call, on the given
channels ("all", "calls" or "messages"). Never covers the patient's other bookings.
confirmed=false only reads the change back; call again with confirmed=true.

BolnaOptOutOut.title: BolnaOptOutOut
BolnaOptOutOut.description: opted_out=false: nothing was changed (read back and call again with confirmed=true).

BolnaVerifyOut.title: BolnaVerifyOut
BolnaVerifyOut.description: A verified booking: no patient data, only what the caller needs read back.

OutboxJobOut.title: OutboxJobOut
OutboxJobOut.description: Operational view of a job: no payload contents.

ReminderOut.title: ReminderOut
ReminderOut.description:
Operational view of a planned contact: ids, times and codes only. No patient data,
message text or provider message id.

StaffAppointmentOut.title: StaffAppointmentOut
StaffAppointmentOut.description:
Minimal fields. patient_name and phone_last2 are filled for owner/admin only (null for
viewer, and when the patient record is missing or cannot be decrypted).

StaffOptOut.title: StaffOptOut
StaffOptOut.description: Opt the appointment's patient out; 'all' covers every purpose or channel.

WebhookReceipt.title: WebhookReceipt
WebhookReceipt.description: accepted: stored with a processing job. duplicate: this event was already stored.
